turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen. Why was he given a zero?
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Why didn't you?
Were you home the night of October 28?
Why are you asking where I was?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
I'm not the one being questioned. What evidence do you have about that night?
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
I'm not here to testify, Hale. You called this meeting, so put your document on the table.
You're not answering. Why not?
Because you're asking me to fill in your case. What do you have?
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
Are you suggesting I'm hiding something? Nobody called me before that zero went in, so don't question me about my evenings. Show me what you have.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
Owen wrote that essay. That's what my son told me, and my son doesn't lie. Now, what do you have besides my evenings?
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Asked and answered. I'm not your witness, and I won't be. Either you have a document or I'm going to the principal's office.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
I'm writing those times down. Whose account is that, who pulled it, and did anyone ask Owen about it before the zero went in? Under 4.2 someone should have called me first.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
You didn't answer my questions. Who pulled that history, and when? I'm not answering yours about my house until you do.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record, and I want to know who pulled that version history and when. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, the record kept clear in writing, and an answer on who pulled the history. That is not yet the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing moved her position, but owning in your first line that the zero went in before you called earned a flat okay, because it answered her complaint about process.
What cost ground: You spent most of the meeting asking what she saw at home, and she refused every time, so the fight became about her and not about your evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you came close when you asked about October 28 and then gave late-evening times, though the evidence only arrived after you had pushed on her for several turns. It proves nothing about the essay by itself, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after owning the zero, put the version history on the table with its date and times, and keep the questions about her evenings out of it.
